_capture.provenance: SYNTHETIC — NOT A RECORDING. No recording of this endpoint exists in the baseline and this programme has no account that could make one: manifest-authenticated.md § Session records that the slot 16-47 capture seeded tokens into localStorage because 'the sign-in form was not scripted: it carries a randomised arithmetic captcha and an SMS OTP, and re-running it burns a real SMS'. B2-AC-36's 'real recorded staging payloads' standard therefore CANNOT be met for any /me/* endpoint and is reported NOT EVALUATED with that reason, never PASS (specs.md § 2.2 Finding I, § 6.11, B9-AC-57).
_capture.credential: none — the rig seeds a synthetic token and never authenticates against any host
_capture.chosen_to_discriminate: The rows are picked to make a wrong implementation FAIL, not to look plausible (§ 6.11). (1) All seven NOTIF_STYLE categories appear — application, case, certificate, document, payment, wallet, announcement — so a mapping that collapses the four dressings cannot pass. (2) Row 8 carries category 'maintenance', which is in NO map, so the announcement fallback is exercised rather than assumed (B9-AC-33); a fixture whose rows all resolved could not fail that test. (3) read_at is present on three rows and absent on five, so both the unread dot and the mark-read branch are reachable. (4) The five unread rows are NOT 3, the value me-notifications-unread-count.json reports: the count endpoint and the row list are different reads and a test that derived one from the other would pass vacuously. (5) sent_at spans minutes, hours, days and months so every relativeTime step below 'year' is reachable. Row 6 lands on a numeric:auto special form ('last month' / 'ເດືອນແລ້ວ'). Row 5 is pinned to exactly -2 days against the oracle's 2026-08-14T00:00:00Z clock, which is the ONE case where the two locales' auto tables disagree: en-GB says '2 days ago' but lo-LA says 'ມື້ກ່ອນ', because Lao names the day before yesterday as one word and English does not. An implementation that handled ±1 auto forms — the obvious reading of numeric:'auto' — passes Tier 1 in English and fails it in Lao on this row alone. (6) Row 8's sent_at is deliberately unparseable, to exercise the empty-string guard the source has at Layout.tsx:76 where Dart's DateTime.parse would throw.
_capture.shape_source: types.ts:752-767 for the row, client.ts Envelope + PageMeta for the wrapper. Paged (api.paged, endpoints.ts:136), called with per_page: 8 (Layout.tsx:117).
_capture.envelope_note: This file carries `_capture`, `data` and `meta` and NOT `success`/`message`, matching every sibling in this directory. The rig (test/fidelity/execute_forms_oracle.mjs) and B9a's tests build the envelope around `data` when they answer; a fixture that carried its own would be unwrapped twice. `meta` is here because /me/notifications is PAGED (api.paged, endpoints.ts:136) and ApiClient.requestPaged reads the block — it is part of the recorded shape, not part of the envelope.
